SENT.title: Payment reported as sent — awaiting the provider's confirmation
SENT.next: Nothing more to do now. The provider's finance team must confirm that the transfer arrived; work starts after that. Do not send this payment again. If it takes long, contact the provider.

RECEIVED.title: Payment confirmed received by the provider
RECEIVED.next: The provider has confirmed the payment and can start the work.

REJECTED.title: The provider reported a problem with this payment
REJECTED.next: Check the transfer with your bank and the provider, then report it again with the correct details.

SENT.title: The station reports that it sent the payment
SENT.next: Check your bank account. Confirm only when the money has actually arrived; work can start after you confirm. If it has not arrived or the details do not match, do not confirm — contact the station.
SENT.problemLabel: What is wrong with the payment?
SENT.problemHint: The station will see this and must report the payment again.

RECEIVED.title: You confirmed receipt of this payment
RECEIVED.next: The job is cleared to start.

REJECTED.title: You reported a problem with this payment
REJECTED.next: The station has to report the payment again.

errors.PAYMENT_ALREADY_REPORTED: This payment was already reported. The page shows its current state.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_SENT_YET: The station has not reported this payment yet.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.confirmed: Receipt confirmed. The job can start.
errors.reported: The problem was reported to the station.
errors.recordedAlready: This payment is already recorded — no new payment was created.
